context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 35 AI Pricing Auto-Apply Rules fully tested. All 4 CRUD endpoints working: GET /api/pricing/auto-apply/rules/{property_id} (returns {rules:[], count}), POST /api/pricing/auto-apply/rules (validates min_confidence 50-100, max_abs_delta_pct 0-100), PATCH /api/pricing/auto-apply/rules/{rule_id}/toggle (flips enabled state), DELETE /api/pricing/auto-apply/rules/{rule_id} (404 if missing). Auto-apply logic in POST /api/pricing/explain works correctly: when AI returns confidence >= rule.min_confidence AND |delta_pct| <= rule.max_abs_delta_pct, the response has decision='accept', auto_applied=true, decision_by='auto:<rule_id_prefix>'. Disabled rules are skipped. Room-specific rules only fire on matching room types. Dashboard includes auto_applied count. Frontend RulesPanel has form with confidence/delta sliders, create button, rules list with toggle (AKTİF/PASİF) and delete buttons. Auto-applied badge shows green CheckCircle banner with 'Otomatik uygulandı' message.
